Lady A - Bigger Picture - Clipping BriefTHE CLIP SHIP  ·  MUSIC CLIPPING CAMPAIGN
Lady A  ·  “Bigger Picture”
Single release campaign  ·  TikTok · Instagram Reels
This is a quiet, faith led song and the campaign should feel the same way. You are not chasing shock value here. You are putting a song in front of people who need to hear it, and getting them to send it to someone else.
QUICK FACTS
Client
	Lady A
	
Song
	“Bigger Picture”
	
Campaign type
	Music promotion. Footage is provided, you edit and post. 
	
Platforms
	TikTok  ·  Instagram Reels
	
Sound
	Official sound only. Links in the Sound section.
	
Page rule
	No restriction. Every page type is welcome on this one.
	
Footage
	HERE
	
On-screen text
	Required. 
	
Length
	8 seconds minimum
	
Audience
	All tiers accepted  ·  English only
	
Approval
	Submit video analytics after 2,000 views
	
Max clipper payout
	30% of budget
	

READ THIS FIRST
The hook on this campaign is the on-screen text, not the edit. The job is to make someone stop, read one line, feel something, and send the video to a person they had in mind. Build every post around that.
	

ABOUT THE SONG
Lady A is the country trio of Hillary Scott, Charles Kelley and Dave Haywood. “Bigger Picture” came to them the day before they went into the studio to finish their next album. They cut it the next day, and a week later learned of Charles Kelley’s cancer diagnosis. The band have said the message of the song is carrying them right now, and that they trust there is a bigger picture. They moved the release up because of the response when they first teased it.
So the record lands as hope in a hard season: doubt, being only human, and choosing to believe anyway. Warm, acoustic, honest. Keep that tone in everything you post.
⚠ Tone and sensitivity, read before you post
The backstory is real and public, and it is not clickbait. Do not build posts around the diagnosis, do not use words like dying, final or last, do not speculate about anyone’s health, and do not fake urgency for views.
Keep the focus on the song and its message. If someone mentions the band’s story in the comments, let it sit, do not amplify it for engagement.
	

THE SOUND   REQUIRED
TikTok: HERE 
Instagram Reels: HERE 

✔ Sound rules
Attach the official sound. Not a re-upload, not your own export, not a cover.
The song is the audio. If you use the live or talking footage, let that voice run first and bring the song in underneath.
	

CREATIVE ASSETS   REQUIRED
Footage folder HERE : acoustic videos, raw clips, and raw footage from a private event where the band played the song live for an audience for the first time.

The best asset in the folder
The live event footage has talking moments at the start that have never been posted anywhere. Only a short performance clip from that night went out on socials. Those talking moments are the strongest hook on this campaign, so use them.
	

✔  Raw clips with no lyrics on them work best. They leave room for your own text.
✔  You may use your own footage for the aesthetic posts. See the next section for what fits.
✖  Do not re-cut the clips the band already posted on their own socials.
CONTENT ANGLES
Five formats that fit this song. Mix them, do not post the same one ten times.
FORMAT
	HOW IT WORKS
	
Talking hook
	Open on the band talking at the private event, cut on the strongest sentence, drop into the performance. Text on screen states what you are about to hear.
	
Acoustic performance
	Straight clip of the acoustic or live performance. One text line sitting over the top. Simple, let the vocal do the work.
	
Aesthetic b-roll lyric videos
	Sunsets, golden hour, open road, sky and clouds breaking, ocean, mountains, rain clearing. Quiet and slow, with a lyric on screen.
	
Faith imagery
	Church light, candles, an open Bible, hands, early morning. Understated and respectful, never preachy.
	
Send to a friend
	Any visual, with text that tells the viewer to send the video to a specific person. This is the format most likely to travel.
	

IF YOU WANT MORE IDEAS
A still frame holding for two seconds while the viewer reads the line, then the visual starts moving.
Text appearing one line at a time in time with the vocal.
Everyday quiet moments: a porch, a drive home, coffee at sunrise, a kid asleep in the back seat.
A storm clearing. Obvious, and it works.
AESTHETIC & FAITH IMAGERY
Two of the formats above are worth spelling out, because they are the easiest to post at volume. Shoot your own or use stock, as long as it is quiet, warm and unhurried. Slow footage, long holds, no fast cuts.
LOOK
	SHOTS THAT WORK
	
Sunsets and sky
	Golden hour over fields, water or a city skyline
Sun breaking through cloud, light through trees
Sky timelapse, clouds moving, the last of the light going
Sunset from a car window on an open road
Silhouettes against the light: a person, two people, a hand out the window
	
Faith based
	Light through a church window, empty pews, candles
An open Bible, a worn page, a hand resting on it
Hands folded, hands lifted, a quiet moment at a service
A cross on a hill, a country chapel, a steeple at dusk
Early morning: coffee, an open journal, light coming in
	

✔  Pair these with one lyric or share line held on screen long enough to read.
✔  Keep it understated. Suggest the faith, do not preach it.
✖  Stock that looks like stock: over-saturated sunsets, cheesy light rays, anything with a watermark.
ON-SCREEN TEXT   REQUIRED
Every post needs text on screen. Use the client lines first. If you write your own, keep it short, plain and human. No hype, no all caps, no sales pitch.
CLIENT LINES, USE THESE AS THEY ARE
✔  Share this with someone that could really use a small lift right now.
✔  Share this with someone to let them know you’re thinking about them.
✔  A reminder that you just got to believe.
✔  Then I remember, I’m only human.
✔  Feeling doubt, but then I’m reminded it’s all part of the Bigger Picture.
MORE IN THE SAME SPIRIT
ANGLE
	EXAMPLE LINES
	
Send it on
	send this to the person you just thought of
someone in your phone needs this today
tag the person who always gets you through it
	
For the viewer
	if this found you on a hard day, that is not an accident
you are allowed to not have it figured out yet
nothing has gone wrong, you just cannot see the whole thing yet
	
Behind the song
	the story behind this song is why it hits
they played this live for the first time at a private show and this is the footage
	

✖ Do not write
Anything about illness, death or dying. Anything that promises a miracle. Anything preachy enough to start a fight in the comments.
	

CAPTIONS & TAGGING
✔  Name the song and the artist in the caption so people can find it.
✔  Keep hashtags relevant: the song, the artist, the mood. #BiggerPicture and #LadyA on every post.
✖  Hashtag spam and unrelated trending tags.
WHAT TO DO
Open the footage folder and the lyric sheet.
Pick one of the five formats and find the clip or b-roll for it.
Cut to at least 8 seconds, with the strongest moment in the first 2 seconds.
Attach the official sound for your platform.
Add your on-screen text, client lines first.
Post with the caption, hashtags and artist tag.
Once you pass 2,000 views, submit your video analytics.
POST REQUIREMENTS   REQUIRED
POST SPECS
✔  At least 8 seconds long
✔  Official sound attached
✔  On-screen text present
✔  Likes and comments on
✔  Each clip posted once per platform
MINIMUM ENGAGEMENT BY VIEWS
PLATFORM
	UNDER 25K
	25K – 100K
	100K+
	
TikTok
	0.9%
	0.8%
	0.5%
	
Instagram Reels
	0.9%
	0.8%
	0.5%
	

THE RULES
✔  YOU MUST
	✖  YOU WON’T GET PAID IF
	
Use the official sound on every post
	You use a re-upload, your own export or an AI cover instead of the official sound
	
Use the provided footage, or your own b-roll for the aesthetic posts
	You build the post around the band’s personal news, or imply anything about anyone’s health
	
Put text on screen on every post
	You post low effort or reposted clips, or you steal another clipper’s edit (instant ban)
	
Keep the tone warm, quiet and respectful
	You spam post, boost through stories, run paid boosts or use collab posts
	
Keep likes and comments on
	You post NSFW, aggressive, mean or rude content
	
Edit your own clips from scratch
	You use AI generated images of the band
	
Post from any page you like, there is no page type restriction
	
	

HOW TO GET APPROVED   REQUIRED
Wait until your video passes 2,000 views.
Screen-record your video analytics: watch time, all view graphs, and locations.
Send the recording to the analytics submission form channel.

⚠ Only submit if you meet the requirements.
Account-level analytics are rejected every time. It has to be the analytics for that individual video.
